items.context:
Little personal side project i have been working on. Build myself a little retro gaming rig out of an old office pc I got for cheap. Came with win 11 pro which I de-bloated (no ads). Who wants to Panzer Dragoon? Hahaha
3 images, no description
items.text: Fun project, and an old office PC is a good starting point for a retro rig. Panzer Dragoon is a great pick to show it off.

items.author: coqui.bsky.social
items.context: COQUI 🐸🔪『3AM 📺& 𝔖𝔬𝔲𝔱𝔥 𝔖𝔦𝔡𝔢 』 anyone know any extra ways to make dos games work? i tried dosbox but no luck!
items.text: A common trip-up is that DOSBox needs the game folder mounted as a drive before you run the exe. GOG also sells many DOS classics with DOSBox already set up, which saves the hassle.
